description: This file defines the Profile class within the Twig\Profiler namespace, implementing profiling functionalities such as timing, memory usage, and hierarchical profiling for Twig templates.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: A class for profiling Twig template rendering, tracking durations, memory usage, and hierarchical profiles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Profile instance with optional template, type, and name, and starts profiling.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template name associated with the profile.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of profile (e.g., root, block, template, macro).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the profile.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type ROOT.

methods.name: isTemplate
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type TEMPLATE.

methods.name: isBlock
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type BLOCK.

methods.name: isMacro
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type MACRO.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Returns child profiles.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Adds a child profile.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration in microseconds.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time in microseconds.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time in microseconds.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns memory usage in bytes.

methods.name: getPeakMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns peak memory usage in bytes.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Starts profiling by recording start times and memory usage.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Stops profiling by recording end times and memory usage.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets profiling data and restarts profiling.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over child profiles.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the profile object.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes data into the profile object.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Internal method for serializing object properties.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Internal method for unserializing data into object properties.
